newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ share prices end steady after peek at new high.
newsitem.headline: NZ share prices end steady after peek at new high.

text.p: * New Zealand share prices end with modest gain
* Market briefly takes a peek at new historic high
* Brokers report heavy volume
Price movements at close
LAST CHG * NZSE40 cap index +2.30 at 2,493.16
372 +2 * NZSC cap index +35.80 at 5,232.59
351 +2 * NZMC .NZMC cap index +3.91 at 1,972.25

754 -1 * Other movers - +25 +5
New Zealand share prices ended firmly on Wednesday but slightly off the intraday record levels set earlier in the session, as stocks with domestic exposure enjoyed their day in the sun.
The NZSE-40 Capital Index ended 2.30 points higher at 2,493.16, just off the highest-ever level for the index of 2,507.65. Turnover, worth NZ$85 million, was again high.
Richard Burton at Cavill White Securities said profit-taking had taken the market off its peak but that it still enjoyed a bouyant tone.
Telecom hit $7.60 before ending one cent down at NZ$7.54 on the day but Fernz was keenly sought, firming five to NZ$5.10.

"What we are seeing is a bit of re-distribution of money into stocks that haven't moved for a bit," he said. In that class, fishing company Sanford, which has suffered from a strong New Zealand dollar, gained five to NZ$2.60.
Likewise, Fletcher Forests, with strong links to both interest rates and the exchange rate, was very strong, firming four to NZ$2.18 on heavy volume.
Brokers said there were still doubts about impending corporate earnings but that the rally appeared to be purely interest rate-driven.

"I think the market is trying to see whether the breakout to these new levels is going to be sustained. Probably the only thing that could upset the applecart would be a large sell-off in the Dow," he said. "That's the risk factor for it," he said.
Among the smaller pure-play New Zealand issues to gain favour was Waste Management which shot up 25 cents to NZ$6.90 on light volume.
-- James Gray, Auckland newsroom +64 9 302 1253
